images.title: 32400 as powers of primes
images.purpose: Shows the ten prime factors of 32400 sorted into three groups, written as 2⁴ × 5² × 3⁴.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One row of ten circles in three coloured groups, each group with a brace and its power.
images.exact_structure: On the left, the label 32400 = in large type. To its right, one row of ten equal circles in three groups with a clear gap between groups: four teal (#0072B2) circles, then two amber (#E69F00) circles, then four reddish purple (#CC79A7) circles. Only the first circle of each group carries its digit: 2 in the first teal circle, 5 in the first amber circle, 3 in the first purple circle; the other seven circles are plain. Under each group a curly brace: under the teal group 2⁴, under the amber group 5², under the purple group 3⁴. Exactly 10 circles and 3 braces. Nothing else.

images.takeaway: Counting each repeated prime factor gives 32400 = 2⁴ × 5² × 3⁴.
